h1: Make Holiday Ad Photos and Videos From One Product Photo
lead: Get a gift-ready holiday scene from one product photo. Add the shipping cutoff, price or offer after download, then reuse the scene for another seasonal push.

faq.q: Can I turn my everyday product photos into holiday versions?
faq.a: Yes. Upload the clear product photo you already use, choose a seasonal setting and keep the product itself recognizable.

faq.q: How do I add "order by" dates to my holiday ads?
faq.a: Type them in Canva, CapCut or Ads Manager after download. Keeping dates off the generated image lets you change them quickly as cutoffs approach.

faq.q: Can my holiday ad include a famous character or celebrity?
faq.a: Requests involving celebrities, public figures, characters or logos owned by other brands may be declined. Generic seasonal touches such as ornaments, snow and wrapping paper are supported.

faq.q: How should I prepare holiday product photos?
faq.a: Start with a clear product photo and describe the seasonal setting. Add dates and shipping cutoffs after download.

faq.q: Do I need to decorate a set or book a creator?
faq.a: No. The seasonal scene is generated around the product photo you upload, so no room has to be decorated and no one has to be filmed. Cutoffs and offers are added after download.

faq.q: Can I use the holiday clips and images as paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloaded files carry no AIVideosUGC watermark and are yours to use in seasonal ads, subject to each platform’s current review rules.

faq.q: Can I add holiday music to a generated clip?
faq.a: Yes. Add holiday music after download in CapCut or your ad editor; AIVideosUGC does not add music to the file.
